card.name: Child psychology references and citations
card.fires_on: Words inside academic citations and summaries about child development and psychology, such as the space before page numbers after a journal volume, or linking words in book chapter titles about children.

modes.label: Page numbers in journal citations
modes.description: The space after the volume number and comma, just before the page range in a child psychology journal reference.
modes.example: Journal of Clinical Child and Adolescent Psychology, 32,<< >>419-429.

modes.label: Words in child-focused titles
modes.description: Linking or descriptive words inside chapter titles or study summaries about children's development and feelings.
